notes.title: Free-to-Play Demo has been released!
notes.content:
[b]<Waltz and Jam> has been meeting players through Steam Next Fest, thank you for all [i]Pilgrims[/i] who had enjoy our demo.[/b]

This Demo includes the very starting point of Waltz and Jam's journey, every pilgrims can follow the path and experience that how these two adorable buddies try to step over the adventures from the Cradle.

To players who already tasted Waltz and Jam, we still suggest new way to rewind this; The Devs' and influencers playing video. Please appreciate of the videos showing how they interpret and understand the whole game and compare to your own style, and broaden our whole experience together.

Pilgrims can receive the next amazing news of <Waltz and Jam> by add this to your Steam Wishlist.

notes.title: Waltz and Jam at Steam's Next Fest starts on Monday, June 10th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882623/f1170f34debae6e891aad321143aeb4179dfe6af.jpg[/img]

Hello, Pilgrims. 👻
From June 10th, Waltz and Jam will be participating in the Steam Next Fest!
Come and enjoy a heartwarming journey and show lots of love for Waltz & Jam. 
And don't forget to follow and wishlist the game if you haven't already🤍

Next Fest Schedule: 
June 10 - June 17 
@10 am Pacific.

notes.title: Free-to-play Demo Released!
notes.content:
We're glad to announce that <Waltz and Jam> has released to open the free-to-play Demo!

This Demo includes the very starting point of Waltz and Jam's journey, every pilgrims can follow the path and experience that how these two adorable buddies try to step over the adventures from the Cradle. For this, famous Twitch influencer, 39daph and kkatamina participated this beginning! Furthermore, the dev team play themselves to share their inspiration with players who love action-adventure genre. 

Enjoy their play and check it out how this world of <Waltz and Jam> appears, and don't forget to play by yourself!

Of course you can receive the next amazing news of <Waltz and Jam> by add this to your Steam Wishlist.
